purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance receipt (レセプト) processing system - monthly billing file creation for self-pay insurance (自費診療) receipts
purpose.summary: ORCR0485 is a batch program in the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that creates monthly billing detail files for self-pay/private insurance receipts. It reads indexed files for patient insurance information, disease names, and claim point/amount data, then produces formatted receipt output files. The program handles editing of disease names, treatment periods, and various insurance claim fields.

notable_features: 34 COPY statements with REPLACING for modular copybook inclusion
Indexed sequential file I/O with FILE STATUS checks
OCCURS tables for hospital/system management data
REDEFINES usage for date field parsing
High comment ratio (26.8%) with Japanese-language comments in EUC-JP encoding
No COMP-3 packed decimal despite financial calculations
215 PERFORM statements indicating structured procedural decomposition
verdict.notes: Source file is encoded in EUC-JP (displayed as latin-1 mojibake); Japanese comments are readable in context. File is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system. Truncated at 16000 chars out of 140641 bytes (3272 lines total), so full procedure division not visible, but structure is clearly production medical billing software.
